children.name: Polyplacotoma
children.description: A placozoan genus discovered in 2019 in the Mediterranean Sea. It has a highly branched morphology distinct from the simple disc shape of other placozoans.

children.name: Polyplacotoma mediterranea
children.description: Discovered in 2019 in the Mediterranean Sea. Uniquely among placozoans, it has a highly branched, irregular shape rather than a simple flattened disc. Represents the second class Polyplacotomia.
